researchMethod.primaryRule: Primary/official sources were preferred for the syllabus and substantive law.
researchMethod.pyqRule: UPSC Prelims overlap questions are adapted/paraphrased and tagged by year; official UPSC previous-paper pages are the canonical source.
researchMethod.explanationRule: Lex Academy explanations are independently written; third-party coaching solution prose is not copied.

sources.title: UPSC Civil Services Examination 2026 Notice - Law Optional syllabus
sources.use: Defines the Law Optional subject scope used to structure the bank.

sources.title: UPSC Previous Year Question Papers
sources.use: Canonical source for Civil Services Preliminary Examination papers and year tagging.

sources.title: Constitution of India - Legislative Department
sources.use: Constitutional provisions, institutions, rights, duties, emergency and amendment questions.

sources.title: India Code
sources.use: Primary statutory source for Contract, Sale of Goods, Partnership, Negotiable Instruments, Arbitration, RTI, IT, environmental, consumer and other legislation.

sources.title: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
sources.use: Territorial sea, contiguous zone, EEZ, continental shelf and high seas.

sources.title: Charter of the United Nations
sources.use: UN organs, peaceful settlement, Security Council and self-defence.

sources.title: Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court
World Trade Organization
sources.use: WTO, GATT, TRIPS and trade-law concepts.

sources.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 - India Code
sources.use: Data Principal, Data Fiduciary, child, Data Protection Board and phased commencement.

sources.title: Mediation Act, 2023 - India Code
sources.use: Mediation, online mediation and mediated settlement questions.

sources.title: Patents Act, 1970 and Copyright Act, 1957 - India Code
sources.use: Patentability, compulsory licensing, copyright and related IPR questions.
